dct_description_sm: Collected to help determine individual identifications for sperm whales and northern bottlenose whales in the Arctic as part of two projects looking at 1) the distribution and movement of cetaceans from known temperate latitudes in the Arctic and 2) the behavioural and vocal response of sperm whales and northern bottlenose whales to controlled sonar exposure.
dct_title_s: Photographic identification images of northern bottlenose whales and sperm whales in Davis Strait
